# David Rice (TechwDR)

> David Rice is a Technology & People Leader and CISSP. On techwdr.com he writes for CIOs and tech leaders about AI governance, AI-era security and leading people through change, from the seat of the person who has to run it.

TechwDR covers:
- AI governance from the operator's seat
- Cybersecurity in the AI era
- Leading technology and global teams through change, people first
